_comment: Cards that exist only for the ability-copying test (tests/unit/test_copy_ability.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_camera` is Peter Parker's Camera -- film counters on arrival and an activated ability that copies a targeted ability you control. `t_gainer` has a plain activated ability with no target, so a copy's effect can be counted; `t_camera_pinger` has one that targets a player, so the new-targets path has something to re-point.

cards.name: Test Camera
cards.oracle_text:
This artifact enters with three film counters on it.
{2}, {T}, Remove a film counter from this artifact: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.

abilities.text: {2}, {T}, Remove a film counter from this artifact: Copy target activated or triggered ability you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.
